about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Range Rover Sport D300 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Range Rover Sport D300 is a current-generation model, introduced in 2022 with the L461 chassis. It uses the AJ300D — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid (MHEV) assistance. This is an Ingenium-family diesel, sharing its architecture with the D300 and D350 found in the L460 Range Rover, as well as the D250/D300/D350 in the L663 Defender. The D300 sits in the middle of the diesel range for the L461 Sport, offering a strong balance of power and efficiency. The D300 is the most commonly requested diesel variant in the current Sport lineup.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D engines for every Range Rover Sport D300 on the road.

codes.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover Sport D300 ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid assistance, fitted to the Range Rover Sport D300 from 2022 to present. No widely-reported engine issue confirmed for this variant specifically — the AJ300D is an improved design over earlier Land Rover diesel engines and does not share the well-documented timing chain pattern of the older TDV6/SDV6 family.
